packageRules.description: Toolchain is pinned to the major version only (gradle/libs.versions.toml); patch selection is Gradle's own toolchain provisioning, nothing to auto-bump here today. Group kept so a future trackable JDK dependency lands here, not mixed into noise.
docs/adr/0008 — QtJambi and its linked Qt must move together, never independently.
docs/adr/0003 — updates land only through the full reference test suite (dev_plan.md §8.3), review accordingly.

No real dependency declarations here — just packaging code listing Qt DLL/so filenames (e.g. `Qt6Core.dll`, `Qt6Gui.dll`) that Renovate's gradle manager misreads as a Maven coordinate, producing a permanent 'failed to look up' warning on the Dependency Dashboard.
